label: 14–21 September 2026
title: Weekly Digest
subtitle: Curated from your sources in English, Spanish and Catalan

stories.headline: China también pide un sistema de seguridad ante la IA mientras acusa a EE.UU. de difundir mensajes amenazantes
stories.summary: China has called for an international security and monitoring system to oversee AI development while criticizing US tech firms for spreading alarming messages that hinder global governance.
stories.why_it_matters: Global powers are vying over international regulations and safety frameworks for AI.
key_facts: Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigned last week
Former Google researcher warned AI could end humanity
Trump opposes AI regulations suggested by OpenAI and Anthropic
Will Rinehart is a researcher at the American Enterprise Institute

articles.title: Un exinvestigador de Google se suma a las advertencias de que la IA podría “acabar con toda la humanidad”
articles.author: Reuters Reuters
articles.summary: A former Google researcher has joined warnings that artificial intelligence could potentially wipe out humanity. Public concern over AI dangers has risen following the recent resignation of Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon.

articles.title: La carrera entre EE.UU. y China por la IA frena cualquier intento de control
articles.author: Francesc Peiron Arques
articles.summary: The technological race between the United States and China over artificial intelligence is hindering regulatory efforts. Donald Trump opposes any AI regulation, despite suggestions from companies like OpenAI and Anthropic.

articles.title: Will Rinehart: “Un pacto para frenar la IA podría infringir la ley antimonopolio”
articles.author: Blanca Gispert Hernandez
articles.summary: American Enterprise Institute scholar Will Rinehart suggested that an agreement to slow down AI development could violate antitrust laws. He predicts a new phase of controlled technological progress.

articles.title: Alarma IA, fiebre Data Center
articles.author: Enric Juliana Ricart
articles.summary: Public alarm and intense focus on artificial intelligence coincide with growing public backlash against data center developments.

articles.title: Les grans tecnològiques cauen a borsa, mentre Donald Trump rebaixa les preocupacions dels grans magnats de la IA
articles.summary: Major tech stocks fell globally, with the Nasdaq dropping nearly 1%, after AI industry leaders warned of future risks and urged a development slowdown. US President Donald Trump downplayed these concerns, while semiconductor firms suffered notable declines.

articles.title: IA: nada ha cambiado, todo debe cambiar
articles.author: Álvaro San Román
articles.summary: An opinion piece argues that recent calls by AI executives to slow development are disingenuous. The author contends that despite acknowledging the risks, developers remain committed to pushing forward their technological advancements.

articles.title: Por qué los dueños de la IA dan un giro de 180 grados y en qué consiste su propuesta de pisar el freno
articles.author: Adhik Arrilucea
articles.summary: Key executives from major AI companies, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and xAI, have aligned in advocating for a slower pace of AI development. Following the debate, OpenAI has delayed its planned initial public offering.

articles.title: La IA se ha caído de un guindo
articles.author: Carme Artigas
articles.summary: AI industry leaders have recently united to urge a pause in development, but the White House rejected the idea, framing AI dominance as a geopolitical necessity. Critics view the tech industry's sudden focus on self-regulation with skepticism.

articles.title: ¿Se puede 'frenar' la IA? Por qué el resto del mundo desconfía del plan de Silicon Valley
articles.author: Carlos del Castillo
articles.summary: Leaders from top AI organizations have surprisingly agreed on the need to slow advanced AI research to ensure control. However, experts, foreign nations like China, and other stakeholders question Silicon Valley's intent and authority to set the pace.

articles.title: Las alertas sobre la IA sacuden unos mercados dependientes de la tecnología
articles.author: Piergiorgio Sandri
articles.summary: Recent warnings regarding artificial intelligence risks have unsettled financial markets heavily reliant on tech investments. The Bank for International Settlements noted that the sector harbors underlying vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Trump al·lega una «conspiració malaltissa» contra la IA i els centres de dades que la generen
articles.author: Pau Espí Solé
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump dismissed warnings from AI company executives, labeling opposition to AI and data centers a sick conspiracy that benefits China. He argued that a strong president is the only necessary safeguard for AI.

articles.title: Per què hi ha una allau d'alertes i por a la intel·ligència artificial?
articles.author: Agustí Sala
articles.summary: Prominent AI leaders have issued warnings about risks posed by untested models, sparking market anxieties. Experts suggest companies fear severe financial backlash if unverified technologies cause major real-world incidents.

articles.title: Nvidia lidera la caiguda a Wall Street per la por sobre la IA
articles.author: Gerard Mira Sánchez
articles.summary: Tech stocks led by Nvidia fell on Wall Street following fears around artificial intelligence development. Concerns grew after the resignation of Jacob Coxon and calls from Anthropic co-founder Dario Amodei for increased AI safety measures.

articles.title: Trump califica de “conspiración enfermiza” la oposición a la IA y dice que él es la barrera de protección
articles.author: Francesc Peiron Arques
articles.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has rejected calls to slow down artificial intelligence development, labeling opposition to AI a sick conspiracy. He argued that existing restrictions are sufficient and that limiting progress only benefits China.

articles.title: De la seguretat a la cursa comercial: la pugna EUA-Xina per la intel·ligència artificial generativa
articles.summary: The dispute over Anthropic has intensified the debate on generative AI regulation between the US and China. China supports regulatory oversight, whereas the United States opposes placing limits on the technology.

articles.title: EEUU y China se enfrentan en el debate sobre la regulación de la IA en plena carrera por su dominio
articles.author: EFE
articles.summary: The US and China are clashing over AI regulation amid competing for technological dominance. Donald Trump opposed new rules after tech leaders like Dario Amodei, Sam Altman, and Elon Musk advocated slowing advanced model development.

articles.title: Trump descarta nuevas regulaciones para la IA: "Hay una conspiración enfermiza"
articles.author: Andrés Gil
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump dismissed calls for new AI regulations following safety warnings from tech leaders and international bodies. The controversy flared up after engineer Jacob Coxon resigned from Anthropic over undisclosed risks in AI models.

articles.title: El debate de la inteligencia artificial: qué dicen sus cuatro líderes sobre frenar su desarrollo
articles.author: David Cuéllar del Rey
articles.summary: Prominent tech leaders are calling for caution regarding the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence. An essay by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposing slower development and stricter safety measures received backing from Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Demis Hassabis.

articles.title: La ONU alerta del peligro de la IA y pide regularla: "Todos los derechos humanos están en riesgo"
articles.author: David Romero González
articles.summary: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk warned that unchecked AI development poses existential threats to human rights, including health, privacy, and safety. His statement follows concerns raised by former Anthropic engineer Jacob Coxon.

articles.title: L’ONU adverteix que l’avenç de la intel·ligència artificial fa perillar tots els drets humans
articles.summary: UN official Volker Türk warned that rapid advancements in artificial intelligence threaten human rights. He highlighted that advanced systems could endanger essential services, critical infrastructure, and democratic institutions.

articles.title: La ONU advierte que todos los derechos humanos “están en riesgo” ante el avance de la IA
articles.author: Autor Agencias
articles.summary: UN High Commissioner Volker Türk warned that artificial intelligence presents flaws that threaten human rights and could undermine democratic institutions.

articles.title: Un expert en IA desacredita l'alerta dels grans magnats: "És absurd pensar que l'eina pot desenvolupar consciència"
articles.summary: An AI expert dismissed recent warnings from tech magnates who claimed AI could become self-aware and destroy humanity. The expert argues the true risks stem from how systems are currently designed rather than sci-fi scenarios.

articles.title: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
articles.summary: It follows the Anthropic CEO's calls for a slowdown in AI development - but in a way that prevents China from pulling ahead in the race.

articles.title: Qué ha pasado con la IA para que sus propios creadores empiecen a temer que pueda escapar a su control
articles.author: Marta Gascón
articles.summary: Concerns over artificial intelligence have surged in recent months, leading its own creators to worry that the technology might escape human control.

articles.title: The risks of AI, according to those who have seen it from the inside: ‘The world is not ready and we are not ready’
articles.author: Patricia Fernández de Lis
articles.summary: Former researchers, executives, and engineers from major AI companies have warned about critical safety failures, military applications, and uncontrollable systems, stating the world is unprepared for these risks.

articles.title: China también pide un sistema de seguridad ante la IA mientras acusa a EE.UU. de difundir mensajes amenazantes
articles.author: Sofía Soler
articles.summary: China has called for an international security and monitoring system to oversee AI development while criticizing US tech firms for spreading alarming messages that hinder global governance.

articles.title: China defiende una IA “orientada al bien” y se opone a narrativas de amenaza o confrontación
articles.author: Autor Agencias
articles.summary: China advocates for AI aimed at the public good while opposing threat narratives, cautioning that misusing the technology could endanger its own political and institutional stability amid competition with the US.

articles.title: Quién gana cuando los dueños de la IA piden que los regulen
articles.author: Esteve Almirall
articles.summary: Tech CEOs including Dario Amodei and Sam Altman are advocating for AI slowdowns and independent safety checks, raising questions about whether regulatory calls serve public safety or corporate self-interest.

articles.title: Teresa Ribera considera “absolutamente preocupantes” los avisos de los gigantes de la IA y aboga por la regulación
articles.author: Antonio M. Vélez
articles.summary: European Commission Vice-President Teresa Ribera expressed strong concern over AI power concentration and supported regulating data centers and AI models to prevent systems from growing out of control.

articles.title: El 'freno' a la IA castiga a ACS y Solaria en el Ibex y arrastra a las tecnológicas asiáticas
articles.author: Economía
articles.summary: Debate over a potential slowdown in artificial intelligence development has caused global stock market drops. Asian tech companies as well as Spanish firms like ACS and Solaria experienced notable losses.

articles.title: Las tecnológicas sufren en bolsa en medio de los temores por el avance de la IA
articles.author: Luis Federico Florio
articles.summary: Technology companies across Europe, the United States, and Asia are experiencing stock market declines due to growing fears surrounding the advancement of artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Sam Altman: “Podríamos perder el control del futuro ante la IA”
articles.author: Francisco Bracero Osuna
articles.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warned that humanity could lose control of the future to AI and highlighted the risk of excessive power concentration within a single government or corporation.

articles.title: China pide una "barrera de seguridad" para la IA ante los intentos de Trump de frenar una regulación global
articles.author: EFE
articles.summary: China's Minister of State Security, Chen Yixin, called for a safety barrier around AI amid global geopolitical competition. China criticized US efforts to restrict its technological advancement, including chip embargoes.

articles.title: La IA, pal de paller de molts nous màsters de casa nostra
articles.author: Esther Escolán
articles.summary: Si hi ha una tecnologia que ha aconseguit revolucionar tots i cadascun dels sectors industrials, empresarials i econòmics a escala global, aquesta ha estat la intel·ligència artificial (IA). Es tracta d’una eina que, entre d'altres, permet automatitzar un gran nombre de…

articles.title: China lanza una alerta sobre los riesgos de la IA en pleno debate sobre los límites de su desarrollo
articles.author: Autor Agencias
articles.summary: China has issued an alert highlighting the risks posed by artificial intelligence amid ongoing debates about setting boundaries on its development. This follows calls from AI firms like OpenAI and Anthropic to slow down advancement.

articles.title: Los cuatro gigantes de la IA piden frenar su desarrollo ante el riesgo de descontrol
articles.author: Marta Gascón
articles.summary: Prominent tech leaders Dario Amodei, Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Demis Hassabis all agree that advanced artificial intelligence development requires stricter controls to prevent a loss of control.

articles.title: La Xina reclama una "barrera de seguretat" per a la IA en ple debat sobre els seus riscos
articles.author: ARA
articles.summary: El ministre xinès de Seguretat de l’Estat, Chen Yixin, ha reclamat la creació d’una "barrera de seguretat" per a la intel·ligència artificial, en un moment de creixent competència tecnològica entre la Xina i els Estats Units. Chen ha situat la IA com un dels principals camps de…

articles.title: Donald Trump es nega a frenar el desenvolupament de la intel·ligència artificial: "Qui guanyi amb la IA, guanya"
articles.summary: Tech leaders are warning about risks from autonomous AI, leading OpenAI CEO Sam Altman to delay the company's IPO. Meanwhile, Donald Trump opposes restricting AI development, framing it as a global race to win.

articles.title: Claus del debat sobre la IA: més veus demanen frenar una tecnologia que pot amenaçar la humanitat
articles.summary: Calls to slow down AI development are growing globally, with China joining demands for caution. Conversely, Donald Trump opposes limits on the technology, viewing it as a competitive global race.

articles.title: Los impulsores de la IA se asustan
articles.author: Jesús Morales
articles.summary: An opinion piece discusses human resilience when facing technological challenges such as artificial intelligence.

stories.headline: Fractura en la Junta Electoral: del "despropósito" del fallo de la ley de nietos a evitar el pulso con el Supremo

The trial investigates the 2001 purchase of Colombian company Inassa by Canal de Isabel II.
Magistrate Manuel García Castellón sent 22 people to trial, including Pedro Calvo and Juan Bravo.
Judge Antonio Narváez blocked voting rights associated with the Democratic Memory Law.

Government ministers criticized judicial corporatism after Supreme Court President Isabel Perelló denounced political attacks against magistrates.

articles.title: La Junta Electoral evita el xoc amb el Suprem i acata el mandat sobre la llei de nets
articles.summary: The Spanish government criticized the Supreme Court's decision to suspend voting rights under the Grandchildren's Law, claiming political intent behind the ruling.

stories.headline: Los líderes de Escocia, Gales e Irlanda del Norte acuerdan luchar juntos para independizarse del Reino Unido

articles.title: Els líders de Gal·les, Escòcia i Irlanda del Nord proclamen el seu dret a l'autodeterminació
articles.summary: Leaders from Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland held an unusual meeting in Cardiff to demand self-determination. They declared their right to decide their own futures at differing speeds.

articles.title: Los nacionalistas de Escocia, Gales e Irlanda del Norte se unen para impulsar su independencia del Reino Unido
articles.author: Rafa De Miguel
articles.summary: Los líderes firman un manifiesto en el que reclaman a Londres que comience a preparar las reformas constitucionales

articles.author: Gerard Mira Sánchez
articles.summary: Political leaders from Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland signed a declaration supporting self-determination. They asserted that Westminster has no right to block democratic processes.

articles.author: Nazaret Romero
articles.summary: Els líders d'Escòcia, Gal·les i Irlanda del Nord han escenificat a Cardiff, la capital gal·lesa, un front comú per intensificar la pressió sobre Londres per la independència. "El temps de Westminster s'està acabant", diu una declaració conjunta signada pel primer ministre…

articles.title: Els primers ministres d’Escòcia, Gal·les i el Nord d’Irlanda segellen l’aliança per l’autodeterminació
articles.summary: The first ministers of Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland sealed an alliance for self-determination. They stated that Westminster's era is ending and called for an equal relationship among nations.

articles.title: Los líderes de Escocia, Gales e Irlanda del Norte acuerdan luchar juntos para independizarse del Reino Unido
articles.author: María Ramírez
articles.summary: Pro-independence leaders of Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland pledged to campaign together to separate from the UK and join the EU. They urged Andy Burnham's Labour government to facilitate constitutional change.

stories.headline: ¿Por qué la ultraderecha baja en Suecia mientras avanza en Europa?
stories.summary: The Sweden Democrats experienced their first electoral decline in four decades as conservative parties adopted elements of their platform. This shift has brought the center-left coalition closer to an election victory.
stories.why_it_matters: Mainstream parties adopting far-right rhetoric is shifting political dynamics and election outcomes in Sweden.
key_facts: The Sweden Democrats lost their position as the second-largest political force.
The Sweden Democrats suffered their first election drop since entering Parliament in 2010.
The Social Democrats recorded their worst electoral result in over a century.
The opposition bloc leads with 95% of the votes counted.

articles.title: Per què l'extrema dreta és el partit que més cau a Suècia?
articles.author: Núria Vila Masclans
articles.summary: Sweden's legislative elections resulted in no clear winner, but saw significant losses for key parties. The far-right Sweden Democrats lost ground for the first time since 2010, while the Social Democrats suffered their worst electoral outcome in over a century.

articles.title: Sweden election is too close to call as far right loses ground
articles.summary: The opposition bloc holds a narrow lead in Sweden's tight general election as far-right parties lose support. Results remain unconfirmed with 95% of votes counted.

articles.title: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call
articles.summary: A preliminary count by Sweden's election authority projected that left-wing opposition bloc would win a three-seat majority.

articles.title: El centreesquerra guanya les eleccions a Suècia per la mínima gràcies al retrocés de l'extrema dreta
articles.author: Marc Orts i Cussó
articles.summary: Sweden's progressive bloc holds a narrow three-seat lead over conservatives following a decline in far-right support. The final election outcome depends on the upcoming count of overseas ballots.

articles.title: L’esquerra sueca s’imposa a la dreta i l’extrema dreta, però per un sol escó
articles.summary: Sweden's left-wing coalition holds a single-seat lead over the right and far-right parties following recent elections. Swedish electoral authorities will resume counting overseas votes on Wednesday to determine the final winner.

stories.headline: Sánchez sitúa hasta "finales de año" el mando único en Ceuta para que la situación pueda quedar "estabilizada"
stories.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced that single command in Ceuta will remain until year-end to resolve the ongoing migration crisis following the arrival of over 70,000 migrants in late July.
stories.why_it_matters: Managing high influxes of migrants presents significant administrative and humanitarian challenges.
key_facts: Government partners suspect blackmail due to opacity on Morocco.
Pedro Sánchez denied Pegasus spyware blackmail allegations.
Sánchez set a timeline to normalize Ceuta by the end of the year.
CNI reports point toward Morocco regarding Ceuta's migration crisis.

articles.title: La opacidad de Sánchez con Marruecos dispara entre sus socios las sospechas de "chantaje"
articles.author: Alejandro Tobalina, Marta Moreno
articles.summary: Pedro Sánchez's opacity regarding Morocco has raised suspicions of blackmail among his political partners.

articles.title: Sánchez rechaza las teorías sobre un chantaje de Marruecos: "La realidad se tiene que construir en base a hechos y no a bulos"
articles.author: Miguel Muñoz
articles.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez dismissed claims that Morocco is blackmailing his government using Pegasus spyware, calling the rumors fake news. He set a target to restore normality in Ceuta by the end of the year.

articles.title: Sánchez, sobre los informes del CNI que apuntan a Marruecos en la crisis migratoria de Ceuta: "No hay datos sólidos que lo prueben"
articles.author: Alexandra Smith
articles.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez stated there is no solid data proving Morocco's involvement in Ceuta's migration crisis, but promised a firm response if evidence emerges.

articles.title: Pedro Sánchez: "Nos hemos dado de aquí al final del año para arreglar la situación en Ceuta"
articles.author: José Enrique Monrosi
articles.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez expects to resolve the diplomatic and migrant crisis in Ceuta by the end of the year, dismissing claims of Moroccan Pegasus spyware blackmail as persistent rumors.

articles.author: Inés García Rábade
articles.summary: Irene Montero, Podemos' candidate for the 2027 Spanish general election, has called for open primaries to build a unified left-wing ballot. She criticized the current government for failing to address housing speculation and price caps.
